def cls(r,g,b):
    mx=max(r,g,b);mn=min(r,g,b)
    if mx-mn<35:
        return '#' if mx>110 else '.'  # gray light / dark
    if r>140 and g<120 and b>120 and r>b: return 'P'  # pink
    if b>r+25 and b>g+15: return 'B'
    if r>130 and g>90 and b<90: return 'Y'
    if r>120 and g<90 and b<90: return 'R'
    if g>r+20 and g>b+20: return 'G'

    row=''
    for x0 in range(0,w,cell):
        block=a[y0:y0+cell,x0:x0+cell].reshape(-1,3)
        from collections import Counter
        c=Counter(cls(*p) for p in block)
        row+=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    print(f'{y0:3d} {row}')
